name: execute the compiled fortran program to regenerate a fixed output file
definition: run the built program so it produces the expected textual output file without the agent deleting or overwriting it.
failure_mode: program not run or output malformed fails the content check

name: implement the metacircular evaluator of a scheme-like interpreter
definition: Write code in the target language whose semantics mirror a reference interpreter: env analysis, procedures with closure capture when closures form, and the evaluator patterns (eval/apply) required by that dialect.
